info.title: Tako Universal API
info.description: Tako is a search engine for visualizing and sharing the world's knowledge. This wrapper exposes Tako's stable API-key-authenticated search, visualization, export, file, and thin-viz endpoints.

post.description: Connects a file to Tako for analysis.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

displayName.description: Optional file name to show inside Tako.

fileUrl.description: Publicly reachable URL that Tako should download and connect.

id.description: ID of the file that was created or connected to

message.description: Message indicating the result of the file connector operation

metadata.description: Metadata of the file that was created or connected to
